_: How the roles of sign_roles.json look and stand, by country (task 017). rules: the kernel's rule numbers (roadsigns.rs) to roles. params: the rules' thresholds (the kernel's N_PARAMS order), a country may override any in its own `params`; warn_m is the distance of a warning before its hazard in the country (CZ rural 100-250 m [TP 65 8.3.1]; UA, PL, DE not read: [Н]). The numbers' sources and what is unverified: docs/research/2026-11-06-road-signs.md, section 3.4 (not read in a primary text: UA heights and lateral offsets, taken from the neighbours). lateral: m from the carriageway's edge to the sign [town, country]; mount: m from the road to the lower edge [town, country]; sizes: m wide by shape [town, country, major road]; order: the groups from the top of a pole down; a group not in it stands alone (DE: a warning stands alone, VwV-StVO Nr. 35a). max_on_pole: most signs on a pole. pole: join_m is how near signs facing the same way share a pole, gap_m the space between two on one pole. roles: the country's own sign for a role of `rules` (a local bus stop sign); off: roles never placed in the country (UA: OpenStreetMap living_street is mostly a yard road there, 150 of them in 26 km2 round Vinnytsia, and a yard has no sign: doubt is no sign).
